interface_detail: REST instances API: POST /v1/instances, plus stop, start, resize, fork, backup and restore
tooling: HTTP API and a CLI; the instance object carries resources so a client can read its real shape
chaining: a sandbox that bills disk alone while stopped, so a long-lived agent workspace can sit idle cheaply
limits_note: disk also caps the shape: 2 to 12 GB on the 2 vCPU shape, 2 to 80 GB on the 4 vCPU/32 GB shape

free_tier.stated: USD 5 of credit after adding a card; no perpetual free tier is published on the pricing page
free_tier.notes: page meta description: 'start with $5 credit after adding a card'

retention.stated: disk billed while you keep the instance; deleting an instance settles its final minutes and billing ends
retention.notes: the disk outlives a stop and dies on delete

egress.terms: not published on the pricing page; recorded as a gap

limits.value: 4 vCPU ceiling on every instance type; a request for more cores returns 4 vCPU at the same price
no published concurrency or start-rate cap on the pricing page

identity_cost.detail: USD 5 of credit is offered after adding a card; the pricing page states no card-free path

evidence.proved: rate is USD 0.80/vCPU + USD 0.70/GB RAM + USD 0.09/GB disk per 730-hour month, metered by the minute; a VM costs 2.5x compute
four shapes with monthly prices: 2/4/12 GB USD 4.76, 4/8 USD 9.34, 4/16 USD 15.48, 4/32 USD 27.76
4 vCPU is the ceiling on every type; an oversize request silently provisions 4 vCPU
REST lifecycle: create, stop, start, restart, resize, fork, backup, restore

notes: Cheapest credible 2 vCPU sandbox that bills disk alone while stopped. The 4 vCPU ceiling is the number that binds an agent that wants 8 cores, and it is silent: the create succeeds with a smaller machine.

session_cap.note: an auto-sleep setting exists; the interval was not read on a page that answered

keep_rate.basis: stopped or sleeping time bills the disk alone, quoted from the sizing page

network_out.ports: services on the sandbox ports are reachable
network_out.note: egress terms and the outbound policy were not on the page read

extras.price_note: compute bills while the instance runs, disk bills every month while the instance is kept. At 300 running hours the compute is USD 1.81 and the disk is USD 0.36 for the month, so the bill is USD 2.17.

binding_note: the 4 vCPU ceiling binds: a create that asks for more cores keeps the memory it asked for and comes back with 4 vCPU, so the shape is capped
